text.en: Dog owners praise trainer Sally for her warm, patient, and highly supportive approach during behavioural consultations. Reviewers emphasize that she listens carefully to owner concerns without judging difficult situations. Handlers report feeling encouraged and well supported throughout one-to-one sessions and guided walks.

Clients consistently mention that the training methods cater thoughtfully to reactive, anxious, and newly adopted dogs. Handlers observe that sessions help dogs remain calm around unfamiliar triggers and pack walk environments. Owners appreciate that lessons involve the whole family while keeping canine welfare the core focus.

Reviewers report significant improvements in managing reactivity, lead pulling, and environmental focus after attending sessions. Multiple owners highlight that practical advice brought tangible behavioural changes within weeks. Handlers gain lasting confidence to walk their dogs safely in new settings and around distractions.

q.en: Does DogSwot offer help with reactive dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently praise the trainer for providing practical strategies and neutral pack walks to manage reactivity.

q.en: Are family members and children included in training sessions?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that training sessions are family-friendly and involve children to maintain consistency at home.

q.en: What formats of training does DogSwot provide?

a.en: The business provides individual one-to-one consultations, small group classes, and structured training walks in Morley.

q.en: How quickly do clients see behavioural progress?

a.en: Owners report noticeable improvements in canine focus and reactivity within a few weeks of following training guidance.
